subject: Dedicated capacity sizing request for Argus Labs — availability & soft-hold
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@arguslabs.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing — Argus late-stage ask

Marcus,

Thanks for the run earlier — Argus is moving to final internal approval and procurement has asked for a short note on dedicated capacity sizing and an option to lock capacity for the initial ramp. We expect to go live with the pilot in mid-September and ramp production in October if procurement signs.

High level: our model (ensemble + retrieval) will need GPU memory and throughput for interactive workloads. Preliminary internal estimates indicate ~12–16 A100 80GB equivalent for the first 60 days, with potential bursts to 20 for onboarding. We need:
- A sizing confirmation from Redwood ops (can you confirm availability in us-west/central for Sep 15 start?)
- A two-week soft hold on the requested capacity while procurement finalizes POs

I've attached our scoping spreadsheet (argus-scoping-v1.xlsx) with estimated concurrency and token profiles. Procurement also asked for a sample capacity hold policy / what a "soft hold" means in practice.

Can you loop in whoever owns dedicated fleet and let us know next steps? We're targeting a final sign-off call with finance/procurement on Sep 2.

Appreciate it —
Liam O'Connor
Head of ML Platform, Argus Labs
liam.oconnor@arguslabs.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@arguslabs.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing — Argus late-stage ask

Team — forwarding Argus' ask. Key asks: sizing confirmation for ~12–16 A10080GB-equivalents starting ~Sep 15, soft hold for ~2 weeks while procurement completes PO, and one-page wording we can share on what a soft hold means.

Quick context: Argus is late-stage (AGS-1721). They're planning a pilot -> prod ramp, expect burst traffic during onboarding. Attached spreadsheet from Argus (argus-scoping-v1.xlsx).

Ops questions for Ben/Neha:
- Can we map that request to current pool availability in us-west && us-central?
- Do we have a mechanism to set a 14–16 node soft hold (no billing, but reserves capacity and prevents new long-term reservations) for 14 days? If not, what workaround (ticketed reservation, internal tag, manual ops hold) do we propose?

Ben — can you run a quick snapshot and give a conservative recommendation (min guaranteed, recommended buffer)? Also flag finance implications if this turns into >90-day reservation.

Karthik — I want a short customer-facing paragraph on the soft-hold policy and an ask to schedule a 30-min alignment with Argus + Procurement for Sep 2.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

----
Attached: argus-scoping-v1.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@arguslabs.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing — Argus late-stage ask

Marcus / team — ran an inventory snapshot and here's what we can commit as a conservative plan.

Inventory summary (us-west / us-central pools):
- Available A10080-equivalent nodes (unallocated): 28 total (us-west 18, us-central 10)
- Long-lead reservations (commits > 30d) scheduled next month: 6 in us-west, 4 in us-central

Recommendation:
- Put a soft hold for 16 A10080-equivalents in us-west starting Sep 14–15. That leaves us a small buffer for existing commitments and supports Argus' 12–16 estimate plus burst to 20.
- Soft hold mechanism: create ticket CS-9842 and tag 16 nodes as "soft-hold:AGS-1721" in inventory. This blocks auto-reassignment and surfaces to scheduling UI but does not trigger billing. If procurement fails to convert within 14 days, the hold expires automatically (we can implement auto-release).
- If Argus requests >90 days or a financial reservation, escalate to Revenue/Finance for committed capacity discounts — need an LOI/PO.

Attachments: capacity-snapshot-20260830.pdf (short ops table)

Operational notes:
- We can provision canary slice (4 nodes) ahead of full ramp to validate kernels and batching config. I suggest quantization profile Q4 (mixed-int8) for cost control during onboarding; we'll keep a fallback to fp16 for perf regressions.
- Neha, can you confirm network egress routes for their VPC/proxy if we do private routing? Argus mentioned sensitive data flows.

I'll open CS-9842 and include retention/auto-release windows. Marcus, could you confirm Argus is comfortable with a 14-day soft hold window and the canary proposal?

— Ben Carter
Capacity & SRE Lead — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@arguslabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing — Argus late-stage ask

Liam — thanks for the details and for the scoping sheet. We're aligned on the path:

Summary of next steps (mutual action plan):
1) Redwood ops (Ben) will open CS-9842 and place a 14-day soft hold for 16 A10080-equivalent nodes in us-west (target Sep 14 start).
2) Argus to confirm PO/LOI status by Sep 2; if PO is ready, we convert the soft hold to a short-term reservation and coordinate billing.
3) Schedule a 30-min technical alignment (canary plan + network routes + quantization profile) on Sep 2 at 10:30 PT. Please confirm availability.
4) Redwood will provision a 4-node canary slice for early validation (no charge unless converted).

Customer-facing soft-hold blurb (feel free to paste into procurement):
"A soft hold reserves identified nodes in Redwood's scheduling inventory for a configurable window (default 14 days) to ensure capacity for a planned onboarding. The hold prevents automatic reassignment but does not create a financial commitment. If the hold is converted to a reservation, standard commitment terms and billing apply."

Links: HubSpot deal — https://app.hubspot.com/deals/AGS-1721 | MAP draft — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Argus-Scoping

Can Liam / procurement confirm the Sep 2 10:30 PT slot and that the soft-hold wording is acceptable?

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Exec — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
